newsitem.title: USA: LatAm to top emerging mkts in next 12 mos - Caspian.
newsitem.headline: LatAm to top emerging mkts in next 12 mos - Caspian.

text.p: Latin American equities are like to show the best returns among emerging stock markets in the 12 months, Caspian Securities said Tuesday.
In a statement linked to the July 25 publication of the firm's global strategy report, Caspian said its preferred markets were Thailand, Brazil and Russia.
"The international environment remains favorable to emerging markets, even though the U.S. equity market has a tired feel to it," the firm said.
"This should enable decent U.S. dollar returns to be achieved in the emerging markets over the next 12 months."
The statement added, "Our highest prospective returns are to be found in Latin America, thanks mainly to exuberant earnings growth expected during the next 12-18 months."
Caspian said it was assuming that U.S. short-term interest rates would increase 0.50 percentage point in the next 12 months.
A U.S. sell-off and a much weaker Japanese yen are the biggest risks emerging markets will face.
Caspian said Asian currencies would face further turmoil in the short term. Malaysia's ringgit and Indonesia's rupiah are the most vulnerable.
"The currency market turbulence should, ironically, be viewed as a positive sign," since it would provide a basis for a renewed bull market.
